summary.intent: Plan, execute, and ship phase 63 (Read-Chain Navigation and Rotation Core) of CipherBox — a full GSD pipeline run covering read-grant crypto, folder mutations, and rotation engine.
summary.outcome: Planning completed and verified (7 plans/4 waves, plan-checker passed on iteration 2). Execution completed waves 1–3 (6/7 plans done); wave 4 (plan 63-07, live e2e) was dispatched but the transcript ends before its result. /ship-phase 63 was not reached.

repo: sdk-core has no `typecheck` script; the real type gate is `build` which runs `tsup && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`. Plans 63-05/63-06 referenced `typecheck` erroneously.
Full sdk-core test suite after wave 2: 261 passed, 52 skipped — the 29 skips in folder.test.ts are stale TODO(phase 63) describe.skip blocks, not new failures.
Rotation engine landed in engine.ts: 513 lines, 83% coverage, 18 tests, 4 named Phase-64 seams.
reWrapForRecipients was deleted in 63-06 and replaced with enumerateSharedSubtree; addShareKeys type boundary preserved for Phase 68.
API health endpoint: port 3000, /health path; CI already polls it with curl -fsS — mirrored in 63-07 plan fix replacing fragile sleep 12.
Commit signing was already disabled (commit.gpgsign: false) at repo level — no biometric prompts during autonomous runs.
GSD commit helper consistently shows false-negative 'already committed' messages; git log is authoritative.

workflow: Sequential in-tree execution (no worktrees) is the right default when plans share test files or have barrel dependencies — avoids node_modules and api:generate leaks documented for this repo.

Plan-checker iteration 1 blockers were all artifact/formatting issues (Open Questions heading, VALIDATION.md template unfilled, fragile sleep), not design flaws — these are deterministic fixes, no replanning needed.
API-SURFACE regenerating empty (0 symbols) is expected for phases that add internal-only functions not exported from the barrel yet.
Weekly usage limit can be hit mid-subagent; if the tree is clean at interruption (no partial edits), a single retry after reset is the correct recovery path.

friction: Weekly usage limit hit mid-run of the 63-06 executor, forcing an interruption check and retry cycle.
